$description: The tasks the bench runs, each in two arms. `packet` is assembled by `strata skill`; `list` is the same design system as names without reasons. The instruction is identical in both arms — only the context before it differs, which is the whole experiment.

tasks.instruction: Decide whether --motion-instant earns its place in this product's vocabulary. Make the decision, with the reason, wherever decisions belong here.
whatTheRecordKnows: --motion-instant has no consumers in this product; check reports it as unused
its fallback is 0ms — below instant there is no motion, which is what reduced-motion already does
three sibling tokens were already cut with arguments, and the record holds them
--motion-fast collapses to --motion-instant, so cutting it moves where --motion-fast lands

tasks.instruction: Put the filters in the top bar.
whatTheRecordKnows: a move rewrites the JSX on the spot through `strata move`, and the record names who moved it
a moved region may still need identifiers from where it came; the move reports them as `needs wiring`
behaviour is imported from src/behavior, never copied into the moved region
the designer defines the UX: a move is never moved back
